dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: I think this one should be called, "Love Turns You into an Unthinking Vegetable"...

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Me? Well, I used to be known as Myweiss the Lovebard... but not anymore. Now I go by Myweiss, Grim Reaper of Romance!

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: What is love but a lie we tell to fool children? Only idiots would believe in something so stupid.

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Ugh, men! They say one thing and do another...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about your ex.

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Hmph. His name was Davy, a bard in name and name alone... Who knows what I ever saw in him.

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: After we were married, he chastised me for having my own pursuits — said I should be taking care of things at home...

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: ...Meanwhile, he was all smiles in front of other girls. I observed him for a time and to be fair, they were all just people in his audience. Still, I felt like there was an accident waiting to happen there...

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Anyway. I get it now. Love is a big hoax, and I need to make sure the women of Mondstadt wise up to it!

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Don't be led astray! There's no such thing as love!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen anyone around that looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: Hmm? You mean, you're looking for a relative?

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: You don't look or dress anything like a local, so I'm sure anyone who looks like you would have made an impression... Sorry, it seems I haven't seen them.

dialogues.speaker: Myweiss
dialogues.text: I hope you find your lost relative soon. You have my full support! Being related by blood is the only real connection you can have in this world. Not love, as some imbeciles would have you believe.
